task: Why are complaints up this week?
answer:
Support tickets and complaints are up this week alongside late deliveries through Hub W2.

- Support tickets rose 86% to 54 tickets this week, with 22 tickets regarding late delivery.
- The on-time delivery rate dropped to 85%, and Hub W2 recorded an on-time rate of 77%.
- "Switch west region deliveries to Courier Y to cut cost" assumed Courier Y delivers at least 90% on time through Hub W2; this week it is 77%.
- "Run the Winter Sale (25% off home) in the west" assumed Hub W2 can carry the Winter Sale volume; this week it is 157%.
